run.what: the commit this batch was generated on; 'local' means it was run by hand rather than by CI

model.name: Z-Image-Turbo
model.licence_note: Apache-2.0 model weights; outputs unrestricted. No account, no terms to accept, no purchase.

content_rules: invented fictional shop name only, no real company names, no real brand logos, no trade marks, no real person, no recognisable faces, no celebrity likeness
rights: Model weights Apache-2.0; outputs unrestricted by the model licence. No third-party asset was an input. Prompts name only in-world Meridian businesses. NOTHING SHIPS UNREVIEWED: every image below is review=pending until a human has looked for anything resembling a real mark or a real face.
caps: --limit: at most 4 picture(s) GENERATED this run; items already on disk that pass the skip check do not count against it

blank_check.what: every written PNG is decoded and its luminance measured; a uniform image is the known Vulkan failure (leejet/stable-diffusion.cpp#1031: blank PNG, exit success)
blank_check.bound: blank when spread <= 2/255 AND stdev <= 1.0, or alpha is 0 everywhere sampled

resume.what: recipe = prompt + negative(if it can act) + size + cfg + steps + seed; a match is skipped, a mismatch is made again

negatives.what: --negative-prompt is passed whenever an item has one; it only ACTS when cfg != 1.0, because sd-cli evaluates the unconditional branch only then

selection.what: only = the ids asked for by name; limit = how many pictures this run may GENERATE, which skipped items do not count against
